objective: Measure the real remaining cycle distribution after composing the activation-calibrated all-Q4_K artifact with the independently exact Clang 21 Q4_K kernel, then select the minimum material kernel or representation intervention needed to approach 2.75 conventional decode tok/s.

quality_anchor.quality_statement: These are retained v23 receipts, not new v33 results. V33 changes only the executable and runs a no-generation graph profile.

prior_evidence.reason_v32_cannot_select_v33_kernel: The v32 stock artifact still contains 288 Q8_0 weight tensors. The v10 quality anchor transcodes all 288 to activation-calibrated Q4_K, so the stock Q8xQ8 hotspot is not assumed to survive.

protocol.raw_perf_data_policy: hash then delete after the CSV report is sealed

analysis.selection_rule: Select only a hotspot with at least 10% exclusive cycles or a measured cross-kernel fusion opportunity whose Amdahl ceiling can materially close the 1.2034x gap. If no such single hotspot exists, require representation reduction or a preregistered multi-group composition.
analysis.forbidden_inference: Do not transfer v32 stock-model shares to v10 and do not interpret profile timing as serving throughput.

resources.checkpoint_retention: no checkpoints; raw perf.data is deleted after hashing

claim_boundary: Diagnostic selection only. No quality, serving-speed, 2.75 tok/s, 100 tok/s, energy, novelty, or breakthrough claim is authorized.
